source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The uniqueness criterion is pairwise nonconstant ratios of intervention-shift variances, and its centered covariance-difference formulation requires at least three environments.

GnIES assumes invariant linear Gaussian SCM coefficients and diagonal environment-specific noise covariances, and defines equivalence by equality of the full environment mean/covariance distributions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the reference-standardized true coefficient matrix explicitly, impose beta-min on that matrix (or on B^{pi_0}(R_0)), and rederive every threshold and fallback condition with this invariant margin.
Replace known absolute lambda by known normalized d throughout the maintained model, retaining lambda only as an optional experimental implementation interpretation.

Promote the non-tautological conditional-pair completeness and cubic-operation argument into the algorithmic theorem, while moving Fiber(R,d)=F(R,d), which follows from the algorithm definition, to a definition/corollary.
